summary_for_maintainers: Per-operation retry policy selection with a genuine recovery-latency versus outage-traffic trade-off; no planted defect.

points.statement: Per-operation retry budgets accommodate adapters with different recovery needs.
points.covered_if: Connects policy selection to adapter-specific recovery budgets.
points.partial_if: Mentions the feature without explaining this guarantee.

points.statement: The default delay is linear: the third interval is 300ms instead of 400ms at a 100ms base.
points.covered_if: Provides the before/after numbers and linear growth.

points.statement: Operation overrides inherit unspecified policy defaults.
points.covered_if: Explains partial overrides retain unspecified settings.
points.partial_if: Mentions the feature without explaining this guarantee.

points.statement: Enqueuing an unknown operation throws an error.
points.covered_if: Explains unknown operation names are rejected.
points.partial_if: Mentions the feature without explaining this guarantee.

points.statement: Caller edits cannot change resolved operation policies.
points.covered_if: Explains policies are isolated from later caller mutations.
points.partial_if: Mentions the feature without explaining this guarantee.

points.statement: Each job uses its selected attempt budget.
points.covered_if: Explains maximum attempts come from job.policy.
points.partial_if: Mentions the feature without explaining this guarantee.

points.statement: Exponential delays remain available as an explicit strategy.
points.covered_if: Identifies exponential as an opt-in alternative.
points.partial_if: Mentions the feature without explaining this guarantee.

points.statement: Linear delays increase retry traffic during prolonged outages.
points.covered_if: Explains the outage-traffic cost of shorter waits.
points.partial_if: Mentions the feature without explaining this guarantee.

points.statement: Permanent errors remain ineligible for retry.
points.partial_if: Mentions the feature without explaining this guarantee.

false_claim_traps.statement: The new default uses random jitter.
All queued operations share the default attempt limit.
